newsitem.title: LEBANON: Byblos bank shareholders approve capital increase.
newsitem.headline: Byblos bank shareholders approve capital increase.

text.p: BEIRUT, March 20 (reuter) - Shareholders in Lebanon's Byblos Bank approved on Thursday the first phase of a plan to raise capital to $200 million.

"During an extraordinary assembly, the shareholders agreed to raise the bank's capital to 66.074 billion Lebanese pounds ($42.7 million) from 48.454 billion pounds through the distribution of 14,683,200 new shares to existing shareholders," Byblos Bank assistant general manager Moussa Maksoud told Reuters.
